description: #6vegrollrecipes   ७ quickly and early veg rolls that everyone likes .. If you like the recipe, please like and share ... I will be happy :)  In this video: Chilli paneer roll Pizza roll Spicy chole roll Cheese corn roll Aloo cheese roll Paneer tikka roll  Chilli paneer roll, veg roll, Veg Frankie, , aloo roll, paneer roll, pizza roll, aloo cheese roll, corn cheese roll, paneer tikka roll, chole wrap, chole roll, ६ आसान और झटपट वेज रोल, veg roll by KabitasKitchen   Dough preparation: All purpose flour - 2 cup Wheat Flour - 1/2 cup Salt-1/4 tsp Cooking Oil-2 Tbsp Water  Pizza roll: Cooked Paratha -1 Cheese - 1/2 cup Onion Capsicum Tomato Olives Jalapeneo Oregano Chilli flakes Pizza sauce -1 tbsp Salt to taste Cooking Oil-2 Tbsp   Chole roll: Cooked Paratha -1  Soaked and Boiled Chole (Chickpeas)- 1/2 cup Onion-1/4 cup Tomato-1/4 cup Ginger garlic paste -1/3 tsp Cumin seeds -1/4 tsp TurMERIC POWDER -1/4 tsp Red Chilli Powder -1/2 tsp Cumin Powder -1/4 tsp Coriander powder -1/4 tsp Garam Masala Powder-1/4 tsp Salt to taste Cooking Oil -2 TBPS Schezwan Chutney -1 tsp Tomato ketchup-1 tsp  Paneer tikka roll: Cooked Paratha - 1 Paneer -100 gms Curd -1.5 tbsp Onion Tomato Capsicum Red Chilli Powder -1/4 tsp Cumin Powder-1/4 TSP Coriander powder -1/4 tsp Garam masala power -1/4 tsp Tandoori masala -1/4 tsp Red Food Colour (Optional) -1 PINCH Tomato ketchup -1 tbsp Green Chilli Sauce - 1 tsp Salt to taste Cooking Oil -2 tbsp  Chilli paneer roll: Cooked Paratha -1 Onion Tomato Capsicum Red Chilli Powder -1/4 tsp Soya sauce -1/2 tsp Green Chilli Sauce - 1/4 tsp Red chilli sauce -1/4 tsp Tomato ketchup -1.25 tbsp Mayonnaise -1 tbsp Salt to taste Cooking Oil -2 tbsp  Cheese corn roll: Cooked Paratha: Cheese - 1/2 cup Sweet Corn-1/4 Cup Onion Tomato Capsicum Chilli Flakes -1/2 tsp Salt to taste Cooking Oil-2 Tbsp Tomato ketchup-1 tbsp Mayonnaise -1 tbsp  Aloo cheese roll: Cooked Paratha: Boiled Potatoes - 2 Cheese - 1/2 cup Green Chilli-1 Onion-1/4 cup Ginger garlic paste -1/4 tsp Tomato -1/4 cup Red Chilli Powder -1/4 tsp Garam masala power -1/4 tsp Salt to taste Chat masala-1 /4 tsp Cooking Oil -2 tbsp Tomato ketchup-1 tbsp Mayonnaise -1 tbsp Green Peas -1/4 Cup  Find me on: Instagram - asr.full_text: 6 type of Veg roll Easy to prepare and taste great I made many different types of veg rolls For which you can watch till the end Please do like and comment Let's start Veg roll Recipe Please subscribe my channel Hit bell icon you will get all notification on my video first make dough for making paratha take 2 cup of Maida and 1.5 cup of Flour you can either use either flour or Maida i am using Mixed two flour add 1.4 tsp salt and 2.5 tbsp oil Mix well Now add 1 tsp salt and 2 tbsp oil Add water and knead dough Like we make chapati, roti and mix well I have mixed well Cover it with a lid and keep to rest for 15 minus 20 minute Then prepare paratha Remove water and cover it and rest it for 15 minutes Add flour once minute knead the dough Make a ball I have used same quantity of flour and flour So we will make total 6 rolls Now let us start rolling Roll into little large size Add all dry flour in a mixing bowl And roll into a round shape We will make stuffing of all paratha Roll all paratha properly We will get all the parathas ready and now, lets start making chilli paneer roll Heat 2 tsp oil in a pan for making chilli paneer roll Add finely chopped green chillies & 2 garlics Cook them, then add chopped onion, used both colors bell pepper You can use green bell pepper to avoid garlic Boil it for 2 mins Add paneer I have taken 100gms paneer Let it cook for half a minute Add ¼ add red chilli powder add salt as per taste Now add soya sauce add green chili sauce add tomato ketchup add red chilli sauce Mix them well Do not add corn may add spring onion if you wish Chilipani is ready, turn gas off and allow it to cool down Meanwhile we will roast the Paratha, we have rolled it As we roast Parathas and bread in normal way, apply oil on both the sides take out the paratha Use a spatula while turning the Paratha If you have experience of cooking and are making roti, make it easier Oil on both the sides Wait for paratha to become slightly golden brown Do not fry them on high flame or on low flame Fry on medium high flame Paratha is ready Take it off the oil and move on to the stuffing In the same, pour 1 tbsp mayonaise and 1 tbsp tomato ketchup Spread both the sauces over the paratha To this put chili paneer You top See how colourful it is Put some finely chopped onion and do not add anything inside We will not use any extra sauce and cheese in this Fold it and press it with a toothpick from centre to get settled Chilli Pani Roll is ready, do try this recipe Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan Add Onions and Chilies I have used two types of Chilies here Saute it for a minute Add 2 color capsicum Use 1 time of green which is okay fry for a minute Usually when we bake, we will fry the vegetables So we will not do all now Vegetables fried, turn off the gas Let it be cool Till then I am making paratha Spread the Pizza sauce over paratha You may add little tomato ketchup with pizza sauce Spread the paratha on the paratha Grate the cheese of your choice Spread cheese in the pizza Then add fried onions and capsicum Spread the pizza topping Add olive and jalapenos Now I am adding oregano and chilli flakes And sprinkle little chilli flakes over it Now top it if you want to our topping tray is completed You may even grate cheese if you want Our pasta is ready You can wrap it this way You may even heat the roll a bit before closing it This is our delicious pizza roll Let us serve it Do try this recipe and add comment Use no. 1 tsp curd, keep 1 tbsp curd in a bowl 1 4 tsp red chili powder 1 4 tsp cumin powder 1 4 tsp coriander powder 1 tsp garam masala powder 1 4 tsp Tandoori masala powder Add salt to taste Mix properly If you want to make a restaurant type paneer tikka then add red food color I have added 100 grams Paneer, mix well Leave the Paneer for 15 minutes After 15 minutes, heat oil in pan We will add Paneer here Keep heat on low Once cream starts to seep in oil cover it with a lid When you add curd into oil, if any gas spills out, just place the pan on a side Cook on a medium flame for 2 mins Add onions with bell pepper Cook for a minute more Cook for 2 mins Add fresh coriander and mix it well and let it cook for 1 minut You can avoid cooking this long, as I have cooked the cottage cheese for 2 minutes and onion, yellow pepper for 1 minute Now paneer tikka stir fry is ready Turn the flame off and let it cool down We will roast the paratha till then We will roast the same quantity of paratha in first batch Then add 1 tbs of tomato ketchup 1 tbs of green chili sauce Mix well and spread well Place the panetika in center of the pan I have already cooked onion and chili And panetika is very nice Add one spoon of mayonnaise Do not use cheese Add 1 tbsp mayonnaise Now our taste will mix well with this You must try this recipe Take this into a plate for serving You may also serve with this in a salad please try making this recipe Firstly for making spicy chole roll heat 2 to 3 tbsp of oil in a pan Add 1 tsp jeera Add 1 cup chopped onion fry the onions on Cook onions for 1 minute Add 1 1⁄3 tsp Ginger-Garlic paste Mix well Then add chopped tomatoes Mix well Mix all ingredients well Now add masalas Add 1 tsp turmeric powder Add 0.5 tsp red chilli powder Add some cumin powder Add some coriander powder Add some garam masala powder Mix everything well As masala cooks well, add boiled chickpeas I have soaked chickpeas I soaked it overnight in water then after 6 6 siti in pressure cooker Add boiled chickpeas, add salt mix it Make it cook on low flame for 2 min use it for stuffing Chickpea wraps are very popular these days That's why I how to make it Our chole is ready so let it cool Meanwhile we will prepare paratha Paratha is ready Apply Segwahan Chutney over paratha If roll is spiced add it Add jejuan chutney and little bit of ketchup for less spiciness Now put it to the centre If you don't like spicy then add mayonnaise, I will use spring onion instead of mayonnaise After that wrap the chhole roll Our roll is ready. I will put back the toothpick You can use butter paper or skewer to wrap it Try chhole roll recipe and you will surely love it or use butter paper to keep it in the refrigerator keep trying the recipe of Chole Roll for making chese corn roll heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan add chopped onions mix it. fry it for 1 minute add capsicum & tomatoes Add tomatoes mix well Mix all the ingredients & cook on medium flame for 1.5-2 minutes We will cook it Add 1 1⁄2 tsp chilli flakes Mix it Add 1 1⁄2 cup sweet corn I have used frozen corn Add Add Add salt 1 more minute Our stuffing is ready After this, we will turn off the heat and keep aside to cool Meanwhile we will prepare Paratha We will add one spoon of mayonnaise and one spoon of tomato ketchup and mix well And spread it to the paratha Put the mixture into a bowl Next add grated cheese Grate it as per your taste I have grated cheese To intensify the flavor, add 1 1 substitute spicy sauce also by adding chili sauce Fold the roll Our very delicious Cheese corn roll is ready This is really amazing Take it out into a serving plate It is ready now, look how lovely it looks Now I will serve this as it is Do eat hot, it is more awesome for kids as well To make aloo cheese roll, heat oil in a pan Add green chili and heat in oil Then add 1 1⁄4 cup finely chopped onion and saute it Add ginger garlic paste, stir it till it is done Add tomato juice Add green peas Mix well Add Red chili powder and Garam Masala powder Add it Add boiled Boiled Potatoes Add Salt Now add boiled Potato-boiled, mashed 2 big potatoes Add salt according to taste Now cook on medium heat for 1 min Don't cook for too long Now potato masala is ready, turn off the flame and cool it In meantime, we will prepare paratha Spread with 1 tsp Tomato Ketchup and 1 tsp tomato ketchup and 1 tsp mayonnaise in a mixing bowl Add potato mixture to it Grate cheese however you like You can decide the taste of cheese according to your choice After adding cheese, sprinkle chopped onion and capsicum Sprinkle some Chaat masala and roll it Our Aloach Cheese Roll You can take this roll in your lunch box So do try it first And to serve the roll , I will serve it on the plate I will try this very quickly So today's recipe for this roll is ready. Do try it, if you love the video then like and share it and please consider subscribing the channel.

segments.text: 6 type of Veg roll
Easy to prepare and taste great
I made many different types of veg rolls
For which you can watch till the end
Please do like and comment
Let's start
Veg roll Recipe
Please subscribe my channel
Hit bell icon you will get all notification on my video
first make dough for making paratha
take 2 cup of Maida and 1.5 cup of Flour
you can either use either flour or Maida
i am using Mixed two flour
add 1.4 tsp salt and 2.5 tbsp oil Mix well
Now add 1 tsp salt and 2 tbsp oil
Add water and knead dough
Like we make chapati, roti and mix well
I have mixed well Cover it with a lid and keep to rest for 15 minus 20 minute
Then prepare paratha
Remove water and cover it and rest it for 15 minutes
Add flour once minute knead the dough
Make a ball
I have used same quantity of flour and flour
So we will make total 6 rolls
Now let us start rolling
Roll into little large size Add all dry flour in a mixing bowl And roll into a round shape
We will make stuffing of all paratha
Roll all paratha properly We will get all the parathas ready and now, lets start making chilli paneer roll
Heat 2 tsp oil in a pan for making chilli paneer roll
Add finely chopped green chillies & 2 garlics
Cook them, then add chopped onion, used both colors bell pepper
You can use green bell pepper to avoid garlic
Boil it for 2 mins
Add paneer
I have taken 100gms paneer
Let it cook for half a minute
Add ¼ add red chilli powder
add salt as per taste
Now add soya sauce
add green chili sauce
add tomato ketchup
add red chilli sauce
Mix them well
Do not add corn may add spring onion if you wish
Chilipani is ready, turn gas off and allow it to cool down
Meanwhile we will roast the Paratha, we have rolled it
As we roast Parathas and bread in normal way, apply oil on both the sides take out the paratha Use a spatula while turning the Paratha
If you have experience of cooking and are making roti, make it easier
Oil on both the sides
Wait for paratha to become slightly golden brown
Do not fry them on high flame or on low flame
Fry on medium high flame
Paratha is ready
Take it off the oil and move on to the stuffing
In the same, pour 1 tbsp mayonaise and 1 tbsp tomato ketchup
Spread both the sauces over the paratha
To this put chili paneer You top See how colourful it is
Put some finely chopped onion and do not add anything inside
We will not use any extra sauce and cheese in this
Fold it and press it with a toothpick from centre to get settled
Chilli Pani Roll is ready, do try this recipe
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan
Add Onions and Chilies
I have used two types of Chilies here Saute it for a minute Add 2 color capsicum Use 1 time of green which is okay
fry for a minute
Usually when we bake, we will fry the vegetables
So we will not do all now
Vegetables fried, turn off the gas
Let it be cool
Till then I am making paratha
Spread the Pizza sauce over paratha
You may add little tomato ketchup with pizza sauce
Spread the paratha on the paratha
Grate the cheese of your choice Spread cheese in the pizza
Then add fried onions and capsicum
Spread the pizza topping
Add olive and jalapenos Now I am adding oregano and chilli flakes
And sprinkle little chilli flakes over it
Now top it if you want to
our topping tray is completed You may even grate cheese if you want Our pasta is ready
You can wrap it this way
You may even heat the roll a bit before closing it
This is our delicious pizza roll
Let us serve it
Do try this recipe and add comment
Use no. 1 tsp curd, keep 1 tbsp curd in a bowl
1 4 tsp red chili powder
1 4 tsp cumin powder
1 4 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp garam masala powder
1 4 tsp Tandoori masala powder
Add salt to taste
Mix properly
If you want to make a restaurant type paneer tikka then add red food color
I have added 100 grams Paneer, mix well
Leave the Paneer for 15 minutes
After 15 minutes, heat oil in pan
We will add Paneer here
Keep heat on low
Once cream starts to seep in oil
cover it with a lid When you add curd into oil, if any gas spills out, just place the pan on a side
Cook on a medium flame for 2 mins
Add onions with bell pepper
Cook for a minute more
Cook for 2 mins Add fresh coriander and mix it well and let it cook for 1 minut
You can avoid cooking this long, as I have cooked the cottage cheese for 2 minutes
and onion, yellow pepper for 1 minute
Now paneer tikka stir fry is ready
Turn the flame off and let it cool down
We will roast the paratha till then
We will roast the same quantity of paratha in first batch
Then add 1 tbs of tomato ketchup
1 tbs of green chili sauce
Mix well and spread well
Place the panetika in center of the pan
I have already cooked onion and chili
And panetika is very nice
Add one spoon of mayonnaise Do not use cheese Add 1 tbsp mayonnaise
Now our taste will mix well with this
You must try this recipe Take this into a plate for serving You may also serve with this in a salad
please try making this recipe
Firstly for making spicy chole roll
heat 2 to 3 tbsp of oil in a pan
Add 1 tsp jeera
Add 1 cup chopped onion
fry the onions on Cook onions for 1 minute
Add 1 1⁄3 tsp Ginger-Garlic paste
Mix well
Then add chopped tomatoes
Mix well Mix all ingredients well Now add masalas
Add 1 tsp turmeric powder
Add 0.5 tsp red chilli powder
Add some cumin powder
Add some coriander powder
Add some garam masala powder
Mix everything well
As masala cooks well, add boiled chickpeas
I have soaked chickpeas I soaked it overnight in water
then after 6 6 siti in pressure cooker
Add boiled chickpeas, add salt
mix it
Make it cook on low flame for 2 min
use it for stuffing
Chickpea wraps are very popular these days
That's why I how to make it
Our chole is ready so let it cool
Meanwhile we will prepare paratha
Paratha is ready
Apply Segwahan Chutney over paratha
If roll is spiced add it Add jejuan chutney and little bit of ketchup for less spiciness
Now put it to the centre
If you don't like spicy then add mayonnaise, I will use spring onion instead of mayonnaise
After that wrap the chhole roll
Our roll is ready.
I will put back the toothpick
You can use butter paper or skewer to wrap it
Try chhole roll recipe and you will surely love it or use butter paper to keep it in the refrigerator keep trying the recipe of Chole Roll
for making chese corn roll heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan
add chopped onions
mix it. fry it for 1 minute
add capsicum & tomatoes
Add tomatoes
mix well
Mix all the ingredients & cook on medium flame for 1.5-2 minutes
We will cook it
Add 1 1⁄2 tsp chilli flakes
Mix it
Add 1 1⁄2 cup sweet corn I have used frozen corn Add
Add
Add salt
1 more minute
Our stuffing is ready After this, we will turn off the heat and keep aside to cool
Meanwhile we will prepare Paratha
We will add one spoon of mayonnaise and one spoon of tomato ketchup and mix well
And spread it to the paratha
Put the mixture into a bowl
Next add grated cheese
Grate it as per your taste
I have grated cheese
To intensify the flavor, add 1 1 substitute spicy sauce also by adding chili sauce
Fold the roll
Our very delicious Cheese corn roll is ready
This is really amazing
Take it out into a serving plate It is ready now, look how lovely it looks Now I will serve this as it is
Do eat hot, it is more awesome for kids as well
To make aloo cheese roll, heat oil in a pan
Add green chili and heat in oil
Then add 1 1⁄4 cup finely chopped onion and saute it
Add ginger garlic paste, stir it till it is done
Add tomato juice
Add green peas
Mix well
Add Red chili powder and Garam Masala powder
Add it
Add boiled Boiled Potatoes
Add Salt Now add boiled Potato-boiled, mashed 2 big potatoes
Add salt according to taste
Now cook on medium heat for 1 min
Don't cook for too long
Now potato masala is ready, turn off the flame and cool it
In meantime, we will prepare paratha
Spread with 1 tsp Tomato Ketchup and 1 tsp tomato ketchup and 1 tsp mayonnaise in a mixing bowl
Add potato mixture to it
Grate cheese however you like You can decide the taste of cheese according to your choice After adding cheese, sprinkle chopped onion and capsicum
Sprinkle some Chaat masala
and roll it
Our Aloach Cheese Roll
You can take this roll in your lunch box
So do try it first
And to serve the roll , I will serve it on the plate
I will try this very quickly
So today's recipe for this roll is ready. Do try it, if you love the video then like and share it and please consider subscribing the channel.
